summary: Iteration 9 frontend verification: routing separation (Redactorium at /, SafeSeed at /safeseed) and compact SafeSeed preset picker. Both core changes look correct. Preset picker is now a single small card (~169px tall) with a dropdown + details area. Routing is clean, no shared ToolkitNav rendered on either page. Two minor concerns flagged.

ui_bugs.issue: Editing a field name in the schema editor immediately collapses the preset-details-<id> card. Spec says renaming a field alone should NOT collapse the details (only choosing a new preset or making structural changes should). After typing 'transaction_id' into field-name-0, preset-details-payments-log became not visible. Likely the SafeSeed page treats any schema mutation as 'custom' and unsets activePreset.

issues: Preset picker card itself fits without overflow (verified). However the page still has ~64px horizontal overflow caused by SchemaEditor row (field-type-0 select + remove-field-0 button + tier-chip pills) extending past viewport. This is a pre-existing SchemaEditor issue, not the new PresetPicker. Redactorium at 390 and both pages at 820 have no overflow.

action_items: Decide intended behavior for detail-card persistence on field rename. If rename should keep details visible, don't reset activePreset on non-structural edits (only on add/remove/reorder or explicit picker change).

(Pre-existing, out of iteration-9 scope) Fix SchemaEditor row on 390px mobile — the type select + remove button + tier chips push horizontal scroll by ~64px. Consider stacking or truncating tier-chip labels on narrow viewports.

Cosmetic console error (dev-only): '<span> cannot be a child of <option>' — this comes from Emergent's Visual Editor instrumentation wrapping option label text in a span. Not app-authored; safe to ignore in production but noisy in dev console.
critical_code_review_comments: App.js catch-all route `*` -> <Redactorium /> means any typo like /safeeed also silently renders Redactorium. Consider a proper 404 or redirect for clarity, or at minimum keep behavior documented.
ToolkitHome.jsx and ToolkitNav.jsx are dead code — remove to prevent accidental re-imports and to shrink bundle.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Verified: (1) `/` renders masthead 'Redactorium', 0 role=navigation, no 'Advokat Frida Toolkit' pill row. (2) `/redactorium` falls through catch-all -> Redactorium page (masthead 'Redactorium'). (3) `/safeseed` renders SafeSeed, no toolkit pill row. (4) preset-select present with 11 options across two optgroups (SafeSeed native / Practical extensions), default 'crm-contacts'. (5) preset-details-crm-contacts shows icon, '5 cols' pill, origin 'SafeSeed native', tagline, comma-separated column names 'account_id, contact_id, full_name, email, phone', tier chips 'structurally-fake: 3, protocol-reserved: 1, authority-reserved: 1'. (6) Changing dropdown to 'payments-log' updates schema editor: field-name-0='txn_id', field-name-7='status'. (7) Step 1 section total height ~169px (was much taller before). (8) Verify + Scan tabs clickable. Known issue: renaming field-name-0 collapses details card (may or may not be intended). Mobile 390: PresetPicker fits, but SchemaEditor causes ~64px overflow (pre-existing).
rca of the issue: Detail-card collapse on rename: The SafeSeed page most likely watches the whole schema array for changes and clears activePreset when the schema no longer matches the preset. A rename is treated the same as a structural mutation, so <PresetPicker activePreset={null}/> hides the details block. Fix: only clear activePreset when column count or types change, or when user selects a new preset — not on pure field-name edits.
